node.statement: Fix an arbitrary finite-dimensional extended epsilon_X-C*-algebra satisfying the root hypotheses. By lem-stage1-original-complementary-pair there are universal C_np<infinity and e_np>0 and, whenever epsilon_X<=e_np, elements q_1,q_2 with q_1+q_2=I_X such that each q_i is a nonvanishing C_np*epsilon_X-projection and ||q_1q_2||,||q_2q_1||<=C_np*epsilon_X. Thus, with d=max{||q_1^2-q_1||,||q_2^2-q_2||,||q_1q_2||,||q_2q_1||}, one has d<=C_np*epsilon_X and q_i^dagger=q_i.
